Class Search Criteria
Search for CSUF Spring/Fall classes - Select "Undergraduate" or "Postbaccalaureate" as the Course Career in the Class Search section.

Search for most CSUF Summer/Winter Session classes, select "Extended Education" as the Course Career in the Class Search section. If you can't find the desired course, select "Undergraduate" or "Postbaccalaureate" as the Course Career.

For CSUF University Extension offerings throughout the year, go to http://extension.fullerton.edu

For questions about registering for classes, contact the Office of the Registrar Helpline at arsc@fullerton.edu or (657) 278-7601.

To view approved General Education courses, visit https://www.fullerton.edu/general-education/student-info/approved-courses.html
